rejected_rule.statement: A creditor may follow property sold by an heir even when assets remain in the estate.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "It is well settled law that transfers by the heirs of an estate are subject to the debts of that estate if, without recourse to the lands transferred, the debts cannot be satisfied" - Soertsz J. in Suriyagoda v. William Appuhamy (supra)
